title: Are you a team player? — идиомы

items.idiom: two heads are better than one
items.example: Two heads are better than one on complex tasks.
items.mnemonic: Две головы лучше на сложных задачах — два хеда: two heads are better than one.

items.example: He shouldn't have to carry the can alone.
items.mnemonic: Не должен нести ответственность один — не будь Кеном: carry the can alone.
